distribution.summary: Southeast China (regional record; provinces unspecified); Taiwan; Guizhou; Jilin
distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports China (SE) and Taiwan. The broad southeast-China record is not converted into provinces. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Guizhou, Jilin as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Chamaecyparis, Thujopsis and Cryptomeria are retained as confirmed genus-level hosts. Pinus and Actinodaphne are explicitly stated to require confirmation and therefore are not promoted to Current Host Summary.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Phloeosinus lewisi Chapuis, 1876.
